title: Unstable Manifolds for the Kuramoto Model: Convergence to the Ott-Antonsen Manifold
summary: In this paper, we study the finite-dimensional, homogeneous, all-to-all coupled Kuramoto model. We begin by performing a complete spectral analysis of all equilibria of the system. Motivated by this analysis, we then derive an explicit description of the unstable manifolds associated with the family of incoherent equilibria. Subsequently, we establish the convergence of this family of unstable manifolds to the Ott-Antonsen manifold $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{OA}}$, with respect to the Hausdorff distance induced by the $p$-Wasserstein metric.
